entries.Original: Click to open · right-click to copy
entries.Translated: 点击打开·右键点击复制

entries.Original: Hello there! I'm a solo developer building FFXIV automation plugins in my free time.
entries.Translated: 你好！我是一名独立开发人员，利用空闲时间构建 FFXIV 自动化插件。

entries.Original: If this one made your day a little easier, the best way to support the project is to share it with other players.
entries.Translated: 如果这个项目让你的日子变得稍微轻松一些，那么支持这个项目的最好方式就是与其他玩家分享。

entries.Original: I'd love to hear from you too: bug reports, feature requests, and general feedback are all welcome on GitHub Discussions.
entries.Translated: 我也很想听到你的消息:bug 报告、功能请求和一般反馈都欢迎在 GitHub 讨论区提供。

entries.Original: Thanks for trying it out, and have fun out there!
entries.Translated: 谢谢你尝试这个，祝你玩得开心！

entries.Original: Automation is disabled until the ToS notice is acknowledged in the main window.
entries.Translated: 自动化将被禁用，直到主窗口确认 ToS 通知。
欢迎来到 Domain Majong Solver

entries.Original: This plugin can play Doman Mahjong for you by reading the game and clicking on your behalf. Before turning that on, please read:
entries.Translated: 这个插件可以通过阅读游戏并代表您点击来为您玩 Doman Majong。在开启之前，请阅读：

entries.Original: Third-party automation is against the FFXIV Terms of Service.
entries.Translated: 第三方自动化违反 FFXIV 服务条款。

entries.Original: Use at your own risk — your account may be sanctioned.
entries.Translated: 使用风险自负——您的账户可能会受到制裁。

entries.Original: "Hints" mode only shows advice — never clicks for you.
entries.Translated: “提示” 模式只显示建议——从不为你点击。

entries.Original: • This build uploads anonymous gameplay logs, error reports, and memory diagnostics from the Mahjong addon to support cross-client reverse-engineering. No character names, Content IDs, or other PII are included — uploads are keyed only by a random per-install ID.
entries.Translated: 该构建从麻将插件上传匿名游戏日志、错误报告和内存诊断，以支持跨客户端逆向工程。不包括角色名称、内容 ID 或其他 PII——上传仅由每次安装的随机 ID 进行键控。
启用自动游戏？##自动游戏确认

entries.Original: Auto-play will click for you with humanized timing.
entries.Translated: 自动游戏将以人性化的时机为您点击。

entries.Original: Switch Mode to Off or Hints any time to stop. Third-party automation is against the FFXIV Terms of Service — use at your own risk.
entries.Translated: 随时切换模式、关闭或提示停止。第三方自动化违反 FFXIV 服务条款——自行承担使用风险。

entries.Original: Waiting for a Doman Mahjong table.
When a match starts, the plugin will:
Hints — outline the best discard in the mahjong window.
entries.Translated: 提示——在麻将窗口中勾勒出最佳弃牌方案。

entries.Original: Auto-play — click the best discard for you with humanized timing.
entries.Translated: 自动播放——点击最适合您的选择，以人性化的时机播放。

entries.Original: Auto-play is active — open a match and the plugin will take over.
entries.Translated: Autoplay 处于活动状态——打开一个匹配，插件就会接管。

entries.Original: Hints mode is active — open a match and watch for the outline.
entries.Translated: 提示模式处于活跃状态——打开匹配并观察轮廓。

entries.Original: Mode is currently Off. Pick Hints or Auto-play above to arm the plugin.
entries.Translated: 模式当前处于关闭状态。点击上方的提示或自动播放来武装插件。

entries.Original: The tile is outlined in the mahjong window.
entries.Translated: 瓷砖在麻将窗口中勾勒出轮廓。

entries.Original: shanten = turns away from ready.  ukeire = tiles that complete your wait — counted as distinct kinds and total copies remaining in the live wall.
entries.Translated: Shanten = 离开准备状态。ukeire = 完成等待的瓷砖——计为实时墙上剩余的不同种类和总副本。

entries.Original: One tile from winning — declare riichi.
entries.Translated: 还差一块就赢了——宣布 Riichi。

entries.Original: Calling completes a set faster than drawing for it.
entries.Translated: 呼叫比绘制更快地完成一个集合。

entries.Original: Discarding this still leaves a winning hand.
entries.Translated: 抛开这一点，仍然留有一手制胜的牌。
距离准备就绪只有一步之遥，

entries.Original: steps from ready — keeps the most useful draws available.
entries.Translated: 准备步骤——保持最有用的绘图可用。

entries.Original: Average delay before each auto-play click.
entries.Translated: 每次自动播放点击前的平均延迟。

entries.Original: Click "Next" on the win/draw results screen so the next hand starts automatically.
entries.Translated: 点击胜利/平局结果屏幕上的 “下一步”，下一手牌将自动开始。

entries.Original: Highlight suggested tile in the mahjong window
entries.Translated: 亮点建议在麻将窗口贴瓷砖

entries.Original: A pulsing outline on the discard to make. Shown in Hints mode.
entries.Translated: 一个脉动的轮廓出现在即将丢弃的物品上。在提示模式中显示。

entries.Original: Large arrow with a DISCARD / TSUMOGIRI label. Keeps the tile art uncovered.
entries.Translated: 带有 DISCARD / TSUMOGIRI 标签的大箭头。保持瓷砖艺术的裸露。

entries.Original: Neon glow halo, L-shaped corner brackets, and a bouncing arrow above the tile.
entries.Translated: 霓虹灯光晕，L 形角支架，瓷砖上方还有一个跳动的箭头。

entries.Original: Show analysis details under best move
entries.Translated: 显示最佳移动下的分析详情

entries.Original: Adds a shanten / ukeire breakdown of the top discards in the main window.
entries.Translated: 添加主窗口中顶部废弃物的 Shanten/ukeire 分类。

entries.Original: Adds a debug button to the main window toolbar.
entries.Translated: 将调试按钮添加到主窗口工具栏。

entries.Original: Asks the policy what to discard and dispatches the click. Only works on your turn.
entries.Translated: 询问策略要丢弃什么，然后发送点击。只有轮到你时才有效。

entries.Original: No snapshot — open a match first.
Discards the tile at a specific hand slot regardless of policy. 0 = leftmost, 13 = just-drawn.
entries.Translated: 无论策略如何，都要在特定手插槽处丢弃瓷砖。0 = 最左侧，13 = 刚刚绘制。

entries.Original: Send a raw call-prompt button index. Enable event-logger in Diagnostics to see which button each index hits.
entries.Translated: 发送原始呼叫提示按钮索引。在诊断中启用事件记录器，以查看每个索引命中的按钮。

entries.Original: pon/pass: 0=Pass, 1=Pon.  chi/pass: likely 0=Chi, 1=Pass.  Verify by logging.
entries.Translated: pon/pass:0=Pass,1=Pont。chi/pass:可能 0=Chi,1=Pass。通过日志记录进行验证。

entries.Original: In-memory address and visibility of the mahjong UI. Empty until you seat at a table.
entries.Translated: 麻将用户界面的内存地址和可见性。空白，直到你坐到桌前。

entries.Original: " not found. Open a Doman Mahjong match in-game.
entries.Translated: 未找到。在游戏中开启多曼麻将对决。

entries.Original: Which variant strategy matched on the current addon. Miss on all = run Bug report → Dump variant.
entries.Translated: 哪个变体策略与当前附加组件匹配？全部失败=运行 Bug 报告→转储变体。

entries.Original: Read-offsets the variant uses to extract your hand, scores, and dora from addon memory.
entries.Translated: 读取偏移变体用于从附加记忆中提取你的手牌、分数和 dora。

entries.Original: (no profile active — addon hasn't been parsed yet)
entries.Translated: (无活动配置文件——插件尚未解析)

entries.Original: Saves the addon + agent memory to a labeled file. Use this when an issue asks for a one-off snapshot. Label = letters, digits, dash, underscore.
entries.Translated: 将插件 + 代理内存保存到标记文件中。当问题需要一次性快照时使用此功能。Label =字母、数字、破折号、下划线。

entries.Original: Writes snap-LABEL-ts.txt to plugin config dir.
entries.Translated: 将 snap-LABEL-ts.txt 写入插件 config dir。

entries.Original: Saves a fresh dump every time the game state changes. Use when you can't predict when the bug will trigger. Caps at 500 files; identical states are dropped.
entries.Translated: 每次游戏状态改变时都会保存一个新的转储。当无法预测错误何时触发时使用。上限为 500 个文件;相同的状态会被丢弃。

entries.Original: Records the very next click you make in the mahjong UI with a label. Type a name, press Arm, then click in-game. Auto-disarms after one click or 60s.
entries.Translated: 用标签记录你在麻将界面中的下一次点击。输入名字，按下手臂键，然后点击游戏内键。一次点击或 60 秒后自动解除武器。
——点击一下或 60 秒后自动解除武装

entries.Original: Auto-play is ON — disarm automation first or its dispatch will race your click.
entries.Translated: 自动播放已打开——请先解除自动化，否则它的调度将与您的点击竞争。
变体转储 (新客户端报告)

entries.Original: Run this when the plugin can't read your hand or board after a game patch. Writes one file to attach when reporting a new client variant.
entries.Translated: 当插件在游戏补丁后无法读取您的手牌或棋盘时，运行此操作。在报告新的客户端变体时，编写一个文件以附加。

entries.Original: Attach emj-variant-dump.txt when reporting a new client variant.
entries.Translated: 在报告新客户端变体时附加 emj-variant-dump.txt。

entries.Original: Open the folder containing every dump file. Drag-and-drop into a GitHub issue to attach.
entries.Translated: 打开包含每个转储文件的文件夹。将其拖放到要附加的 GitHub 问题中。

entries.Original: Most recently produced dump files. Open reveals the file's folder; Copy puts the full path on your clipboard.
entries.Translated: 最近生成的转储文件。打开显示文件的文件夹;复制将完整路径放在剪贴板上。

entries.Original: Logs every UI callback the mahjong addon receives. Useful for reverse-engineering button indices; heavy when on — turn off when done.
entries.Translated: 记录麻将插件接收到的每个 UI 回调。对逆向工程按钮索引很有用;开启时很重——完成后关闭。
记录到 emj-events.log 的点击

entries.Original: Tracks every discard the moment it commits. Strategy is auto-picked at startup: native asm hook preferred, addon-poll as fallback.
entries.Translated: 追踪每次丢弃的时刻。策略在启动时自动选择：原生 asm hook 优先，addon-poll 作为备用策略。

entries.Original: Anonymous upload of error/finding/memdump files to the project's research endpoint. URL resolves from GitHub at startup.
entries.Translated: 将错误/查找/memdump 文件匿名上传到项目的研究终端节点。启动时从 GitHub 解析 URL。

entries.Original: lines of today's errors and findings NDJSON. Click Open to inspect the full file.
entries.Translated: NDJSON 今天的错误和发现。单击 “打开” 以查看完整文件。

entries.Original: Outlines every visible node whose dimensions match a tile, in NodeList order — before the row-finder picks the closed-hand subset. Use to spot tiles the size filter missed or extras the Y-cluster heuristic drops.
entries.Translated: 列出每个尺寸与瓦片匹配的可见节点，按 NodeList 顺序排列——在行查找器选择闭合子集之前。用于发现大小过滤器遗漏的瓦片或额外的 Y-cluster 启发式丢弃。
概述所有检测到的瓦片直线

entries.Original: walknodes: every UI node in the addon. findtiles: scan memory for tile-encoded values. atkvalues: the addon's parameter array.
entries.Translated: walknodes:插件中的每个 UI 节点。findtiles:扫描内存中的磁贴编码值。atkvalues:插件的参数数组。

entries.Original: Finds which byte inside each pool-tile slot encodes the tile id, by comparing slots with different tiles. Used to locate fields when a client patch moves them.
entries.Translated: 通过比较不同磁贴的磁贴槽，找出每个池磁贴槽中哪个字节对磁贴标识进行编码。用于在客户端补丁移动字段时定位它们。

entries.Original: Walks types 1021..1024 and diffs candidate tile bytes across visible slots.
entries.Translated: 行走类型 1021..1024，并在可见插槽之间移动候选磁贴字节。

entries.Original: Raw bytes of the addon (or AgentEmj) over a chosen range. Defaults target the current best-guess region.
entries.Translated: 在选定范围内的 addon(或 AgentEmj) 的原始字节。默认值针对当前最佳猜测区域。
使用带可选 0x 前缀的十六进制。
附加内存 (偏移量 + 长度)

entries.Original: Same idea as Hex dump but addon-only and written to emj-dump.txt. Convenient for fixed-offset structures.
entries.Translated: 与 Hex 转储的想法相同，但只有附加功能，并写入 emj-dump.txt。适用于固定偏移量结构。

entries.Original: Print every game UI addon currently loaded. Substring filter; empty = all. Used to confirm the mahjong addon name on your client.
entries.Translated: 打印当前加载的每个游戏 UI 插件。子串过滤器;空 = 所有。用于确认客户端上的麻将插件名称。

entries.Original: What the auto-play loop saw last tick. Updates live during a match.
entries.Translated: 自动游戏循环在最后一刻看到了什么？比赛中的实时更新。

entries.Original: Health of the discard-capture hook and ongoing data-collection counters.
entries.Translated: 丢弃 - 捕获钩子和持续数据收集计数器的健康状况。

entries.Original: Lights up during a chi/pon/kan offer. opt= is the button index the plugin would click.
entries.Translated: 在 chi/pon/kan 优惠期间亮起。opt=是插件将点击的按钮索引。

entries.Original: No accept-side action on offer — not a call prompt.
entries.Translated: 没有提供接受方行动——没有呼叫提示。

entries.Original: Top 5 discard candidates ranked by shanten / ukeire / dora. Highlighted tile is the policy pick.
entries.Translated: 前五名弃用候选人由 shanten / ukeire / Dora 排名。突出显示的是政策选择。

entries.Original: No snapshot — not in a match, or the addon struct is not readable.
entries.Translated: 没有快照——在匹配中没有，或者插件结构无法读取。

entries.Original: Open the Doman Mahjong Solver window. Type /mjauto help for the full command list.
entries.Translated: 打开 Doman Majong Solver 窗口。键入/mjauto 帮助以获取完整的命令列表。

entries.Original: '. Type /mjauto help for the command list.
entries.Translated: 输入/mjauto 帮助命令列表。

entries.Original: (enable "Developer tools" in Settings for debug commands)
entries.Translated: (在调试命令的 “设置” 中启用 “开发者工具”)

entries.Original: [MjAuto] Usage: /mjauto capture <label>. Run again with no label to disarm. File:
entries.Translated: [MjAuto] 使用/mjauto capture <label>。再次运行，没有要解除的 label。文件：

entries.Original: [MjAuto] capture label must be [a-zA-Z0-9_-] only — got '
entries.Translated: [MjAuto] 捕获标签必须是 [a-zA-Z0-9_-] 只能——明白了 “

entries.Original: [MjAuto] auto-play is ON — its dispatches would race your manual click. Run `/mjauto off` first, then re-arm capture.
entries.Translated: [MjAuto] 自动游戏开启——它的调度会与你的手动点击竞争。先运行/mjauto off，然后重新捕获。
点击游戏中的动作一次。

entries.Original: Auto-disarms after one click or 60s. File:
entries.Translated: 一键或 60 秒后自动解除武装。文件：

entries.Original: [MjAuto] snap label must be [a-zA-Z0-9_-] only — got '
entries.Translated: [MjAuto] 快捷标签必须是 [a-zA-Z0-9_-] 只有——搞定了 “
[MjAuto] 自动快照 ON。哈希去伪，min 缺口

entries.Original: Files: snap-auto-NNN-<ts>.txt in plugin config dir.
entries.Translated: 文件:snap-auto-NNN-<ts>.txt 在插件 config dir 中。

entries.Original: Toggle off then on to reset.
[MjAuto] Emj addon not found — open a table first.
entries.Translated: [MjAuto] 未找到 Emj 插件——先打开一个表。
[MjAuto] 事件记录器 ON。写信给
使用十六进制，可选 0x 前缀。
[MjAuto] AtkStage 无法使用 (游戏中没有？

entries.Original: [MjAuto] no snapshot — not in a match.
tiles — not a discard state. Wait for your turn.
entries.Translated: 瓷砖——不是丢弃状态。等待轮到你。

entries.Original: not found in hand — internal error.
entries.Translated: 未在手中发现——内部错误。

entries.Original: [MjAuto] Mahjong addon not found — seat at a table first, then retry.
entries.Translated: [MjAuto] 麻将加号未找到——先找张桌子坐下，然后再试。

entries.Original: and attach this file when reporting a new client variant.
entries.Translated: 并在报告新的客户端变体时附加此文件。
手动结果 - 下一步终止：状态已移动
